meta.name: Operation MBBS Hindi 720p
meta.description:
Operation MBBS chronicles the lives of three first year students - Huma, Sakshi and Nishant in one of the best MBBS colleges in the country. Follow their journey as they navigate through friendships, hardships and medical student life.

Returning Series · First aired 22 Feb 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: Dice Media, Pocket Aces Pictures · Network: YouTube

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 not on server

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Infection
videos.overview: Follow Nishant, Sakshi and Huma, first year MBBS students, as they navigate the first few weeks of college and meet quirky, unique people. An incident in the dissection hall ends with Nishant figuring out how to apologize to the two girls.

videos.title: Diagnosis
videos.overview: A month into the first year of MBBS, Nishant, Huma and Sakshi balance an infinite syllabus, difficult practicals and the desire to actually enjoy their college life. But as their party comes to an abrupt end, they learn something about Nishant which changes their perception of him.

videos.title: Complications
videos.overview: Mid term results are in for our students and they're in for a surprise. As they celebrate their results, they realize that there's something much deeper at play which they need to address.

videos.title: Surgery
videos.overview: As Huma struggles to gain back the confidence she's lost, Rukmini gives her a tricky solution. Meanwhile, as the three hold on to their resentments against each other, a heartbreaking event forces them to reconsider what it is that really matters to them.

videos.title: Recovery
videos.overview: Huma, Nishant and Sakshi gear up for their final exams. As Huma considers whether to cheat or not, the others learn something about her which irreversibly changes her image.
